views.name: v_invoice_aging
views.description: Open invoices (issued, not yet paid) with how many days past due they are and the aging bucket they fall in: current, 1-30, 31-60, or 61+ days overdue.
views.definition:
SELECT i.id AS invoice_id,
       i.invoice_number,
       i.account_id,
       a.name AS account_name,
       i.total,
       i.due_on,
       greatest(current_date - i.due_on, 0) AS days_overdue,
       CASE
           WHEN i.due_on >= current_date THEN 'current'
           WHEN current_date - i.due_on <= 30 THEN '1-30'
           WHEN current_date - i.due_on <= 60 THEN '31-60'
           ELSE '61+'
       END AS aging_bucket
FROM billing.invoice AS i
JOIN accounts.account AS a ON a.id = i.account_id
WHERE i.status = 'open'

views.name: v_subscription_current
views.description: The live subscriptions (trialing, active, or past due) with the account and plan, the days until renewal, the plan price as a monthly figure, and the usage reported so far this period against the plan allowance.
views.definition:
SELECT s.id AS subscription_id,
       s.account_id,
       a.name AS account_name,
       pl.code AS plan_code,
       pl.name AS plan_name,
       s.status,
       s.current_period_start,
       s.current_period_end,
       s.current_period_end - current_date AS days_until_renewal,
       s.cancel_at_period_end,
       CASE pl.billing_interval
           WHEN 'month' THEN pl.price
           WHEN 'year'  THEN round(pl.price / 12, 2)
       END AS monthly_equivalent_price,
       billing.usage_in_period(s.id, s.current_period_start, s.current_period_end) AS usage_this_period,
       pl.included_units
FROM billing.subscription AS s
JOIN billing.plan AS pl ON pl.id = s.plan_id
JOIN accounts.account AS a ON a.id = s.account_id
WHERE s.status IN ('trialing', 'active', 'past_due')

routines.name: prorate
routines.description: The part of a period charge that applies from a change date to the end of the period, by days. Used to credit the unused part of the old plan and charge the new one when a subscription changes mid-period. A change date outside the period is clamped to it.
routines.signature: prorate(p_amount numeric, p_period_start date, p_period_end date, p_change_on date)

routines.name: run_billing_cycle
routines.description:
Bills every live subscription whose current period has ended by the given date. For each one it raises an open invoice with the plan fee and any usage beyond the plan allowance, stamps the usage events it billed, and then renews the subscription for the next period, or cancels it if it was set to cancel at period end. Subscriptions still in a free trial are rolled forward without an invoice.

Commits after each subscription, so it must be called outside a transaction block.

routines.name: usage_in_period
routines.description: Total usage units reported for a subscription from the start date (inclusive) to the end date (exclusive), whether or not they have been billed.
routines.signature: usage_in_period(p_subscription_id uuid, p_period_start date, p_period_end date)

views.name: v_category_tree
views.description: The category hierarchy flattened with a recursive query: each category with its depth (0 for a root), its full path, its root, and how many active products sit directly in it. Rows are in tree order.
views.definition:
WITH RECURSIVE tree AS (
    SELECT c.id,
           c.parent_category_id,
           c.id AS root_category_id,
           c.code,
           c.name,
           c.sort_order,
           0 AS depth,
           c.name::text AS path,
           ARRAY[c.sort_order, 0] AS sort_key
    FROM catalog.category AS c
    WHERE c.parent_category_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.id,
           c.parent_category_id,
           t.root_category_id,
           c.code,
           c.name,
           c.sort_order,
           t.depth + 1,
           t.path || ' > ' || c.name::text,
           t.sort_key || c.sort_order
    FROM catalog.category AS c
    JOIN tree AS t ON t.id = c.parent_category_id
)
SELECT t.id,
       t.parent_category_id,
       t.root_category_id,
       t.code,
       t.name,
       t.depth,
       t.path,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM catalog.product AS p WHERE p.category_id = t.id AND p.is_active) AS active_product_count
FROM tree AS t
ORDER BY t.sort_key, t.path

views.name: v_product_availability
views.description: Every active product with the stock it has across active warehouses: units on hand, how many warehouses hold it, whether any is in stock, and whether the total has fallen to the combined reorder points.
views.definition:
SELECT p.id AS product_id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       catalog.category_path(p.category_id) AS category_path,
       p.unit_price,
       coalesce(s.quantity_on_hand, 0) AS quantity_on_hand,
       coalesce(s.warehouse_count, 0) AS warehouse_count,
       coalesce(s.quantity_on_hand, 0) > 0 AS is_in_stock,
       coalesce(s.quantity_on_hand, 0) <= coalesce(s.reorder_point, 0) AS needs_reorder
FROM catalog.product AS p
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT sl.product_id,
           sum(sl.quantity_on_hand)::integer AS quantity_on_hand,
           sum(sl.reorder_point)::integer AS reorder_point,
           count(*)::integer AS warehouse_count
    FROM inventory.stock_level AS sl
    JOIN inventory.warehouse AS w ON w.id = sl.warehouse_id AND w.is_active
    GROUP BY sl.product_id
) AS s ON s.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.is_active

routines.name: apply_stock_movement

views.name: mv_customer_lifetime_value
views.description: One row per customer with their order count, lifetime spend, and first and last order dates, counting orders that were placed and not cancelled or refunded. Customers who have not ordered have a count of zero. Refresh with reporting.refresh_materialized_views.
views.definition:
SELECT c.id AS customer_id,
       c.display_name,
       c.account_id,
       count(oh.id)::integer AS order_count,
       coalesce(sum(oh.total), 0) AS lifetime_value,
       min(oh.placed_utc) AS first_order_utc,
       max(oh.placed_utc) AS last_order_utc
FROM sales.customer AS c
LEFT JOIN sales.order_header AS oh
       ON oh.customer_id = c.id
      AND oh.status IN ('placed', 'paid', 'shipped', 'delivered')
GROUP BY c.id, c.display_name, c.account_id

views.name: mv_daily_sales
views.description: Sales per day for orders that were placed and not cancelled or refunded: order count, units, gross sales, discounts, net revenue, and average order value. Refresh with reporting.refresh_materialized_views.
views.definition:
SELECT oh.placed_utc::date AS sale_date,
       count(*)::integer AS order_count,
       sum(u.unit_count)::integer AS units_sold,
       sum(oh.subtotal) AS gross_sales,
       sum(oh.discount_total) AS discounts,
       sum(oh.total) AS net_revenue,
       round(avg(oh.total), 2) AS average_order_value
FROM sales.order_header AS oh
JOIN (
    SELECT ol.order_id, sum(ol.quantity) AS unit_count
    FROM sales.order_line AS ol
    GROUP BY ol.order_id
) AS u ON u.order_id = oh.id
WHERE oh.status IN ('placed', 'paid', 'shipped', 'delivered')
GROUP BY oh.placed_utc::date

views.name: mv_low_stock
views.description: Active products whose stock across active warehouses has fallen to or below their combined reorder points, with how far short they are. The purchasing worklist. Refresh with reporting.refresh_materialized_views.
views.definition:
SELECT p.id AS product_id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       sum(sl.quantity_on_hand)::integer AS quantity_on_hand,
       sum(sl.reorder_point)::integer AS reorder_point,
       (sum(sl.reorder_point) - sum(sl.quantity_on_hand))::integer AS shortfall
FROM inventory.stock_level AS sl
JOIN inventory.warehouse AS w ON w.id = sl.warehouse_id AND w.is_active
JOIN catalog.product AS p ON p.id = sl.product_id AND p.is_active
GROUP BY p.id, p.sku, p.name
HAVING sum(sl.quantity_on_hand) <= sum(sl.reorder_point)

views.name: mv_monthly_recurring_revenue
views.description: Monthly recurring revenue per plan: the live (active or past-due) subscriptions on it and what they bring in each month, with yearly plans divided by twelve. Trials are not counted. Refresh with reporting.refresh_materialized_views.
views.definition:
SELECT pl.id AS plan_id,
       pl.code AS plan_code,
       pl.name AS plan_name,
       count(s.id)::integer AS subscription_count,
       coalesce(sum(
           CASE pl.billing_interval
               WHEN 'month' THEN pl.price
               WHEN 'year'  THEN round(pl.price / 12, 2)
           END
       ) FILTER (WHERE s.id IS NOT NULL), 0) AS mrr
FROM billing.plan AS pl
LEFT JOIN billing.subscription AS s
       ON s.plan_id = pl.id
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'past_due')
GROUP BY pl.id, pl.code, pl.name

views.name: mv_top_products
views.description: Products ranked by revenue across all orders that were placed and not cancelled or refunded, with units sold. Refresh with reporting.refresh_materialized_views.
views.definition:
SELECT ranked.product_id,
       ranked.sku,
       ranked.name,
       ranked.units_sold,
       ranked.revenue,
       rank() OVER (ORDER BY ranked.revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank
FROM (
    SELECT p.id AS product_id,
           p.sku,
           p.name,
           sum(ol.quantity)::integer AS units_sold,
           sum(ol.line_total) AS revenue
    FROM sales.order_line AS ol
    JOIN sales.order_header AS oh ON oh.id = ol.order_id
    JOIN catalog.product AS p ON p.id = ol.product_id
    WHERE oh.status IN ('placed', 'paid', 'shipped', 'delivered')
    GROUP BY p.id, p.sku, p.name
) AS ranked

routines.name: refresh_materialized_views
routines.description: Refreshes every materialized view in the reporting schema without blocking readers. Schedule it (for example with pg_cron) or call it after a batch of changes.

views.name: v_order_summary
views.description: One row per order with its customer, line and unit counts, totals, captured payments, and the balance still due. The main query for order lists and customer service.
views.definition:
SELECT oh.id AS order_id,
       oh.order_number,
       oh.status,
       c.id AS customer_id,
       c.display_name AS customer_name,
       c.email AS customer_email,
       coalesce(l.line_count, 0) AS line_count,
       coalesce(l.unit_count, 0) AS unit_count,
       oh.subtotal,
       oh.discount_total,
       oh.tax_total,
       oh.shipping_total,
       oh.total,
       coalesce(p.paid_amount, 0) AS paid_amount,
       oh.total - coalesce(p.paid_amount, 0) AS balance_due,
       oh.placed_utc,
       oh.created_utc
FROM sales.order_header AS oh
JOIN sales.customer AS c ON c.id = oh.customer_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ol.order_id, count(*)::integer AS line_count, sum(ol.quantity)::integer AS unit_count
    FROM sales.order_line AS ol
    GROUP BY ol.order_id
) AS l ON l.order_id = oh.id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT pay.order_id, sum(pay.amount) AS paid_amount
    FROM sales.payment AS pay
    WHERE pay.status = 'captured'
    GROUP BY pay.order_id
) AS p ON p.order_id = oh.id

routines.name: apply_discount_code
routines.description: Applies a discount code to a draft order and recomputes its totals. Fails if the code is unknown, inactive, expired, used up, or does not reduce this order (for example the subtotal is below its minimum).
routines.signature: apply_discount_code(p_order_id uuid, p_code text, p_principal_id uuid)

routines.name: cancel_order
routines.description: Cancels an order that has not shipped: returns its stock to the warehouses it came from, marks captured payments refunded, gives back the discount code use, and moves the order to cancelled. An order that has shipped fails on the status guard trigger and nothing is changed.
routines.signature: cancel_order(p_order_id uuid, p_principal_id uuid, p_reason text)

routines.name: discount_amount
routines.description: How much a discount code takes off a subtotal at a point in time: the percentage or fixed amount, never more than the subtotal. Zero when the code is unknown, inactive, outside its validity window, or the subtotal is below its minimum.
routines.signature: discount_amount(p_discount_code_id uuid, p_subtotal numeric, p_at timestamp)

routines.name: guard_order_line_change
routines.description: Trigger function for sales.order_line: rejects adding, removing, or changing the product, quantity, or price of a line once its order has left draft.

routines.name: guard_order_status
routines.description: Trigger function for sales.order_header: rejects a status change that is not allowed by sales.is_valid_order_transition and stamps the timestamp that goes with the new status.

routines.name: is_valid_order_transition
routines.description:
Whether an order may move from one status to another. Cancelled and refunded are final.

draft -> placed -> paid -> shipped -> delivered, with cancel allowed until the order ships and refund allowed after.

routines.name: next_order_number
routines.description: The next human-readable order number, such as SO-100042. The default for sales.order_header.order_number.

routines.name: order_balance
routines.description: What a customer still owes on an order: the order total less its captured payments. Null for an unknown order.

routines.name: order_line_changed
routines.description: Trigger function for sales.order_line: after a line is added, removed, or repriced, refreshes the totals on its order.

routines.name: place_order
routines.description: Places a draft order: takes the stock for every line out of the warehouses (one inventory.stock_movement per warehouse used), counts the discount code use, and moves the order to placed. All or nothing: if any line cannot be filled, nothing is changed.

routines.name: record_order_status
routines.description: Trigger function for sales.order_header: writes a sales.order_status_history row when an order is created and each time its status changes, attributed to the principal that made the change.

routines.name: record_payment
routines.description: Records a captured payment against a placed order and, when the payments cover the order total, moves the order to paid. Rejects a payment larger than the balance still owed.
routines.signature: record_payment(p_order_id uuid, p_method sales.payment_method, p_amount numeric, p_external_reference text, p_principal_id uuid)

routines.name: refresh_order_totals
routines.description: Recomputes an order's subtotal, discount, tax, and shipping from its lines and discount code. Called by the order_line_totals trigger and by sales.apply_discount_code.

routines.name: shipping_charge
routines.description: The shipping charge for an order subtotal: a flat 7.50, free from 100.00, and nothing for an empty order.
